Binding properties of sodium glucose co-transporter-2 inhibitor empagliflozin to human serum albumin: spectroscopic methods and computer simulations. Empagliflozin is an oral sodium glucose co-transporter-2 inhibitor for type 2 diabetes mellitus. The interaction between empagliflozin and human serum albumin (HSA) was investigated experimentally and theoretically.
